name: Blood in the Streets
label: Quest
description: Dalaran's barrier has come down, and turmoil grips the city. With its patrols dealt with, Magus Wordeen Voidglare says there is no better time to slip…
intro: Dalaran's barrier has come down, and turmoil grips the city. With its patrols dealt with, Magus Wordeen Voidglare says there is no better time to slip inside and learn the mages' secrets. You are to carry the key from the internment camp to the city's sewers on its northern edge.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Whatever caused Dalaran's barrier to lower has left the city in turmoil. With you having dealt with their patrols, there is no better time than now to make our way inside and discover their secrets.

Take the key you found at the internment camp and seek out their sewers along the northern border of the city. With luck, those mages had no reason to put a ward over such a... Disagreeable point of entry.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I think you will find that key won't be enough to get past my wards. You didn't truly think we would leave such a vulnerability open at a time like this, did you?

clips.title: Completion
paras: It is surely no coincidence the horde has taken an interest in my city during such a precarious time.
In fact, I was counting on it. I have a proposition for you.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
